name: Town of North Castle
gaps: R-4A/R-2A/R-1.5A/R-1A schedule sets height in feet only (30 ft); no story limit
R-MF and R-MF-A have separate perimeter / attached-lot / detached-lot rows; only the district-level row is in the fields (others in notes)
RMF-SCH lot size, yards and coverage set by the Town Board per project; GCCFO lot size and yards set by the Planning Board
Accessory side/rear values are the note (g) half-distance for one-story accessory buildings under 800 sf; larger accessory buildings need full principal setbacks
GB (R-1/2A uses) and NB (R-2A uses) also allow one-family houses under those districts' rules; not added
Corner-lot side yard on the side street = required front yard (§ 355-15I) recorded for one-family districts and R-2F only
Split-zoned county codes (with '*') follow each part's rules

wetlands.summary: Ch. 340: wetland buffer is 100 ft from the wetland edge or watercourse bank, widened up to 150 ft where slopes over 25% drain toward it; buffer is regulated like the wetland itself (permit for structures, grading, clearing, vegetation removal).

steep_slopes.summary: § 355-18: no disturbance of steep slopes (25%+ over a 25 ft area), visible hilltops or ridgelines without a disturbance permit (Building Dept or Planning Board); SWPPP required. Steep slopes are deducted 50% from net lot area for new one-family lots.

trees.summary: Ch. 308 Art. II: permit to remove any tree (8 in.+ DBH) in the regulated setback zone (25/15/12/10/5 ft from lot lines in R-4A/R-2A/R-1.5A/R-1A/other), any significant tree (24 in.+ DBH), trees in wetlands, more than 10 trees a year, or clearing more than 5 trees per 1/4 acre.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 267: SWPPP required for land development activity (soil disturbance of 5,000 sf or more).

adu.summary: § 355-40K: one accessory apartment per lot by Planning Board special permit in single-family districts; owner-occupied; min 300 sf; max 33% of house GFA up to 2,000 sf plus 25% of GFA over 2,000 sf; max 2 bedrooms; waiting periods after CO/purchase.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings max 1 story, 15 ft, 800 sf (2 stories/22 ft by special permit with principal setbacks, not in front yard); one-story accessory buildings under 800 sf may sit at half the principal side/rear setback but not nearer the street than the front setback (Schedule col. 3 item 5, note (g)).
general.pools: Pools (plus surrounding decks, cabanas and equipment) need principal-building setbacks; not in the front yard unless set back 3x the required distance on a lot 3x the minimum area (§ 355-15L).
general.notes: § 355-26D caps exterior wall height (lowest grade to roof measuring point) at 38 ft in R-4A/R-2A, 36 ft in R-1.5A/R-1A, 34 ft elsewhere. Height is measured to the mean roof level; highest roof plane may be 5 ft above the limit. New lots use net lot area and need a minimum contiguous buildable area (§ 355-26F).

R-4A.name: One-Family Residence, 4 acres

max_impervious_coverage.note: Gross land coverage (§ 355-26C): all buildings, structures and paved, gravel and semipervious paver areas; +10 sf per foot of front setback beyond the minimum. Net lot area for newly subdivided lots.

max_floor_area.note: § 355-26B table, all one-/two-family dwellings irrespective of district. Under 5,000 sf the rule is '1,875 sf or 50% of lot area, whichever is greater' (split at 3,750 sf). Net lot area for lots created by new subdivision. Attics and qualifying basements with 7.5 ft+ ceilings count.

accessory.notes: Note (g): one-story accessory buildings under 800 sf may be half the principal side/rear distance, not nearer the street than the front setback; accessory buildings limited to 1 story/15 ft/800 sf (up to 2 stories/22 ft by Planning Board special permit, then principal setbacks and not in front yard).

R-4A.source: § 355-21 Schedule of Residence District Regulations (Attachment 1); § 355-26B-C (GFA and gross land coverage tables); § 355-15I (corner lots)
R-4A.notes: Height 30 ft (no story limit); up to 35 ft by Building Engineer if 5 nearest homes average over 30 ft (§ 355-26E). Max exterior wall height 38 ft (§ 355-26D).

R-MF.name: Multifamily Residence
R-MF.notes: Main row shown (10-acre site). Perimeter 24 acres; attached-unit lots 5,000 sf (front 20, side 10 (0+10), rear 15, 35%); detached-unit lots 7,500 sf (front 20, side 10 (10+15), rear 15, 35%). Yards doubled next to a single-family district (note k). R-1A uses (incl. one-family houses) permitted as regulated in R-1A. Density 1 unit per 25,000 sf net lot area (§ 355-24B).

R-MF-A.name: Multifamily-A Residence

accessory.notes: Perimeter side yard 6 ft for accessory structures

R-MF-A.notes: Perimeter (5-acre site) row shown. Attached-unit lots 2,500 sf (front 10, side 0, rear 10, 50%); detached-unit lots 7,000 sf, width 65, depth 60 (front 10, side 6 / 3 accessory, rear 10 / 6 accessory, 35%). Uses same as R-MF.

R-MF-SS.name: Residential Multifamily - Single Structure

max_floor_area.note: § 355-28B, on net lot area, all in a single structure

R-MF-SS.notes: Uses same as R-MF (incl. R-1A uses).

RMF-SCH.name: R-MF-SCH Multifamily - Senior Citizen Housing

max_floor_area.text: 0.15 to 0.4 FAR on net lot area, set by the Town Board at zoning approval (§ 355-27)

RMF-SCH.notes: Senior citizen housing only; lot size, yards and coverage 'to be determined by the Town Board at the time of zoning approval'.

GCCFO.name: Golf Course Community Floating Overlay

max_building_coverage.note: Applied to the whole GCCFO district area as one lot

GCCFO.notes: Active-adult community tied to an 18-hole golf club on 150+ acres of R-2A land; lot size and yards set by the Planning Board at subdivision; 100 ft perimeter buffer kept as golf course; height measured to mean level of primary roof from finished grade at main entry; density 1 unit per 1.8 acres.

RO.name: Residence Office

max_impervious_coverage.note: Gross land coverage (§ 355-26C): all buildings, structures and paved, gravel and semipervious paver areas; +10 sf per foot of front setback beyond the minimum. Net lot area for newly subdivided lots.

max_floor_area.note: Schedule FAR for the district; one-family dwellings are also subject to the § 355-26B GFA table

RO.source: § 355-23 Schedule of Office and Industrial District Regulations (Attachment 3)
RO.notes: Permits any R-5 use 'as regulated therein', so one-family houses are allowed; offices also permitted. See § 355-30I.
